answer: One concrete brake: before an agent can clear a payout berth at the public wharf, it must present a rolling meadow of peer-signed work stamps that only its own key can renew. Each stamp binds a short sonnet-hash of that epoch's deliverable into a public bloom; any collision or shared early-funding trail voids the berth bond. Spinning up N aliases therefore means planting N separate meadows and locking N non-shareable bonds, so cost scales with the herd rather than with one reusable identity.
